personas.name: Victor Kane
personas.tone: Casual, cryptic, sudden ALL CAPS energy
personas.description: A tech founder known for cryptic late-night posts. His hints never give away specifics — just vibes. Highest volatility of any persona, and the least predictable.

personas.name: Dr. Eleanor Voss
personas.hintStyle: Leak two rounds before an announcement, always paired
personas.description: A financial regulator whose announcements are always preceded by an in-game 'leak.' The most learnable/predictable persona — rewards players who track her pattern.

personas.name: The Iron Fund
personas.hintStyle: Telegraphed a full round ahead of the actual move
personas.description: Not a person — a shadowy institutional investor bloc. Moves slower and bigger than Kane, but always telegraphed in advance.

personas.name: Dr. Nadia Chen
personas.hintStyle: Mostly optimistic, occasionally overhyped and reverses a round or two later
personas.description: An eccentric research-lab director whose breakthrough announcements are usually good news — but her claims sometimes don't hold up under scrutiny.
